# Audio

`game.audio` defines sounds from files, plays them, controls music, volumes and sustained sounds. The kit is Experimental in the [stability tiers](stability.md). `game.audio.play` plays a sound def by name.

`define` takes clip paths inside a mod's `Sounds` folder, without the extension, and makes a sound def you play with `play` or `play_at`. A looping sound is defined in XML with `sustain` and started with `sustainer_start`.

```lua
game.audio.define("MyMod_Ding", { "MyMod/ding1", "MyMod/ding2" }, { volume = 0.8, pitch = 1.1 })
game.audio.play("MyMod_Ding")
game.audio.set_volume("music", 0.3)
game.audio.play_song(game.audio.songs()[1].def)
```

## Functions

| Function | Parameters | Returns | Description |
|----------|------------|---------|-------------|
| `game.audio.define` | `name, clips, opts?` | `boolean` | Defines a sound from clips in a mod's Sounds folder (paths without extension). Play it with game.audio.play. |
| `game.audio.sound_defs` |  | `string[]` | Every sound def. |
| `game.audio.songs` |  | `RimSongInfo[]` | Every song def. |
| `game.audio.play_song` | `def` | `boolean` | Starts a song now. |
| `game.audio.silence_music` | `seconds` | `boolean` | Silences the music for a while. |
| `game.audio.volume` | `kind` | `number` | Volume of game, music or ambient sound, 0 to 1. |
| `game.audio.set_volume` | `kind, value` | `number` | Sets a volume and saves the preference. |
| `game.audio.sustainer_end` | `id` | `boolean` | Stops a sustained sound. |
| `game.audio.play_at` | `map, def, x, z` | `boolean` | Plays a sound at a cell, louder when the camera is near. |
| `game.audio.sustainer_start` | `map, def, x, z` | `integer` | Starts a looping sound at a cell. Returns an id for sustainer_end. |
